findings.text: follow-on: a section whose plan resource does not resolve (resolve_resource returns None) and the two earlier returns (no section reference at :399, no repo and no authority at :401) still record section_routing as None, so an unmounted or unreadable plan stays indistinguishable from a section carrying no raise -- the defect this change repairs for the raised case; the reviewed manifest names this under follow_ons and it is a separate decision, not a regression in this node.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is the four-file gate run at base and at head with a named control; the manifest records base 18 passed/5 failed (EXIT=1) and head 23 passed (EXIT=0), and the control log reddens three cases (EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a dispatch whose section routing rule cannot be resolved records the failure with its exception class and the section, distinguishable from a section with no raise, and still falls back to role routing; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:420 returns the failure record and :3869 still takes role routing when it is present.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, carries structured baseline_suite and after_suite JSON, the three gate log paths, the declared negative control whose path is a bare path, and names its own early-return follow-on rather than hiding it.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_a_raise_failure_is_visible.py, docs/evidence/fragments/section-contract-and-computed-impl/a-raise-failure-is-visible.html and a figures directory; the diff c091e7c9..8bbf49dd touches exactly the first three, so every changed path is inside scope and the worktree is clean at 8bbf49dd.

justifications.durability: the declared control (the failure dropped so _dispatch_section_routing returns None) reddens test_a_malformed_rule_records_its_failure_and_still_dispatches, test_a_malformed_rule_is_not_reported_as_a_section_with_no_rule and test_the_pointer_carries_the_failure_too, and each assertion is independent of the value it guards (the exception type is re-derived by a direct resolve_section_routing call and the raise list is a literal).
justifications.evidence: the manifest's structured arms (base 18 passed/5 failed EXIT=1, head 23 passed EXIT=0) each name their revision, tree, module and cwd in logs/gate-*.log, the control log reddens three cases, and I independently reproduced the head file (5 passed, EXIT=0).
justifications.fit: the change matches the surrounding idiom in reckon/crew/dispatch.py (a typed record trimmed to evidence, the payload/pointer two-carrier pattern) and introduces no plan label, ticket, version name or author attribution; the section token in the test is the domain section reference the code resolves.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:420 returns a failure record naming the exception class and section while :3869 leaves the backend on resolve_role, so the three states the goal names are distinguishable at the landing.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff c091e7c9..8bbf49dd is inside the manifest's declared write paths, the worktree is clean, and both commits carry a conventional subject with a body and no attribution.
